failure_repairs.failure: live gateway list omitted a desktop-created session immediately after POST /agent-sessions returned it
failure_repairs.root_cause: the sandbox runs AGENT_LOCAL=true, and the agent-sessions router bypassed requireAuth entirely in that mode. Although the desktop sent a valid Bearer token, req.auth was never populated, the catalog row stored owner_user_id=NULL, and the strict user/project ownership upsert correctly refused to claim the engine session. SDK identity persistence itself is synchronous before the 201 response, and the live test's explicit projectId and cwd match the paired device's selected project.
failure_repairs.fix: use optional authentication on local agent-session routes: requests without a token retain loopback compatibility, while a present Bearer token is validated and attached (invalid tokens fail closed). Keep ownership creation transactional with setSdkSessionId, and make stream-bridge child rows inherit the parent's owner/project and claim their SDK identity in the same transaction. No polling was added because the desktop persistence event is synchronous.
